proposals.title: Establish a New Board Committee on Decarbonization Risk
proposals.topic_summary: Charter a new Board committee to review corporate strategy and responses to activist-established decarbonization timelines and related risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Reduce Executive Stock Holding Period
proposals.topic_summary: Require senior executives to retain 50% of equity pay stock until normal retirement age, and prohibit hedging of such shares.
proposals.evidence: The Board believes this proposal is unnecessary. Strong forfeiture and hedging policies are already in place.

proposals.title: Additional Carbon Capture and Storage and Emissions Report
proposals.topic_summary: Annual report on CO2 stored underground through enhanced oil recovery, and the net difference versus emissions from burning the produced oil.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Additional Direct Methane Measurement
proposals.proponent: Sisters of St. Francis Charitable Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Report analyzing reliability of methane emission disclosures, including direct measurement outcomes and plans to validate and improve estimates.
proposals.evidence: the Board believes that this proposal is duplicative and, therefore, unnecessary.

proposals.title: Establish a Scope 3 Target and Reduce Hydrocarbon Sales
proposals.topic_summary: Set a medium-term reduction target for Scope 3 emissions from use of energy products consistent with Paris Agreement goals.
proposals.evidence: We believe setting Scope 3 targets can have significant unintended consequences for society, and therefore we recommend a vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Additional Report on Worst-case Spill and Response Plans
proposals.topic_summary: Report evaluating economic, human, and environmental impacts of a worst-case oil spill from Guyana operations and cleanup response commitments.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: GHG Reporting on Adjusted Basis
proposals.topic_summary: Disclose a recalculated emissions baseline excluding emissions from material asset divestitures since 2016.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote against this proposal, as it narrowly focuses on divestments

proposals.title: Report on Asset Retirement Obligations Under IEA NZE Scenario
proposals.proponent: Legal & General Investment Management America, Inc.
proposals.topic_summary: Audited report estimating quantitative impacts of the IEA NZE scenario on all asset retirement obligations.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that shareholders vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on Plastics Under SCS Scenario
proposals.topic_summary: Audited report on how a significant reduction in virgin plastic demand under the System Change Scenario would affect financial position and assumptions.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote against this unnecessary proposal.

proposals.title: Litigation Disclosure Beyond Legal and Accounting Requirements
proposals.topic_summary: Actuarial assessment of potential cumulative risk to the Company from current environment-related litigation.
proposals.evidence: we strongly recommend a vote against it.

proposals.title: Tax Reporting Beyond Legal Requirements
proposals.topic_summary: Issue a tax transparency report prepared in consideration of GRI Tax Standard indicators, excluding confidential information.
proposals.evidence: For these reasons, the Board recommends a vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Energy Transition Social Impact Report
proposals.topic_summary: Report on social impact on workers and communities from facility closure or energy transition, and mitigation alternatives.
proposals.evidence: the Board views the proposal as unnecessary and wasteful of Company resources, and recommends voting against the proposal.

proposals.title: Report on Commitment Against AMAP Work
proposals.topic_summary: Public report assessing benefits and drawbacks of committing to no oil and gas exploration and production in the AMAP area, including the Arctic Refuge.
proposals.evidence: The Board therefore encourages shareholders to vote against this proposal.
